chipset.docs:
**enum**: The chipset to apply known timings from.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

is_rgbw.docs:
**boolean**: Set to `true` if the strip is RGBW. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

is_wrgb.docs:
**boolean**: Set to `true` if the strip is WRGB. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

max_refresh_rate.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: A time interval used to limit the number of commands a light can handle per second. For example 16ms will limit the light to a refresh rate of about 60Hz. Defaults to sending commands as quickly as changes are made to the lights.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

num_leds.docs:
**int**: The number of LEDs in the strip.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the data line of the light.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

rgb_order.docs:
**string**: The RGB order of the strip.

*See also: [Beken SPI LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/beken_spi_led_strip#configuration-variables)*
